title: Grandfather and Boys with Kitten, 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage sepia snapshot from around 1930 featuring a man, likely a grandfather or father, sitting on brick porch steps outside a stucco home with two young boys and a small kitten. The older man wears a newsboy cap, suit, and eyeglasses, while the boys are dressed in classic early 20th-century children's attire. The older boy holds a tiny kitten on his lap.
